If a mover has no company news, check whether another company's event moved it (customer, supplier,

## Company Name (TICKER) `[Category]`

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.

## Illumina, Inc. (ILMN) `[Pharma]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in window.
- Weil Company Inc. disclosed a 17.5% reduction in its Illumina stake during the third quarter; the filing was reported on October 15, 2026 (The Stock Observer, Oct 15; publish time not available).
- Ninety One North America disclosed a new position of 16,418 shares valued at approximately $4.493 million, while Ninety One UK disclosed a third-quarter purchase of 1,356,397 shares; both disclosures were reported on October 15, 2026 (MarketBeat; The Cerbat Gem, Oct 15; publish times not available).

## Strategy Inc (MSTR) `[AI Infrastructure]`
- Strategy shares rose 5.04% on Thursday, October 15, 2026; no company earnings release or filing in the available results directly explained the session move.
- MSCI approved new rules on Thursday, October 15 that could exclude companies classified as non-operating businesses; Strategy was identified as a potential exclusion, with MSCI’s affected-company list scheduled for November 11 and the rules taking effect after November 30 [report] (Yahoo Finance, Oct 15 20:08 ET).
- JPMorgan estimated that a potential MSCI exclusion could put approximately $2.8 billion of passive fund flows at risk (Investing.com, Oct 15; publish time not available).
- Strategy purchased 250 BTC for approximately $21.5 million during October 5–11, 2026, its smallest weekly acquisition of 2026, while directing $192.4 million toward repurchasing STRC preferred shares (Investing.com, Oct 15; publish time not available).
- Michael Saylor said on October 13, 2026 that Bitcoin had bottomed and would return above $100,000; the comments were reported during the October 15 window (Simply Wall St, Oct 15; publish time not available).
- No confirmed after-hours or pre-market Strategy price was available in the search results through 02:03 ET on October 16, 2026.
